title: MSCR Pontoons
specs: Boats operate on Lakes Monona and Mendota
Youth under 20lbs may not board per US Coast Guard recommendations
Participants 12 and under must wear life jackets for entire trip
Boats wheelchair accessible only at Tenney Park loading site
Each boat max 15 participants plus crew; crew count in max capacity
Groups of 6 or more advised to arrange private rental
includes: Life jackets for children 20lbs or over
Safety equipment, flotation devices, deck chairs
blurb: MSCR maintains 3 pontoon boats at Tenney Park Boat House for drop-ins, specialty trips, and private rentals. Boats hold up to 15 participants plus crew, are wheelchair accessible only at Tenney Park, and provide life jackets for children 20lbs or over. Drop-in rides run June 1 to September 30 at four locations with $5 per person fee, no reservations, and are subject to weather cancellations.
extraNote: No programming on Memorial Day, Juneteenth, 4th of July, Labor Day · Cancellation due to weather or high water levels; call weather line 608-204-3044 ext 4 · Groups of 6+ should contact for private rental; drop-in rides no reservations · Tenney Park Boat House, 1615 Sherman Ave · May through September
